question: Flying-V, a futuristic and fuel efficient airplane is developed by researchers in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Netherland.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Flying-V airplane**

__
 
• Its unique design places the **passenger cabin, the cargo hold, and the fuel tanks in the wings.**
 
• Experts hope that the** plane's aerodynamic shape** will cut fuel consumption by** 20% compared to today's aircraft**.
 
• Experts tested a** 22.5 kg and 3-meter scale model, **developed by **researchers at the Delft University of Technology in the Netherlands** and **partner Dutch airline KLM.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• The** most fuel-efficient airline was Norwegian Air Shuttle.**
 
• A **blended wing** is often presented as the most efficient aircraft design.
 
• **Flying-V aircraft **will have a length of** 55m, **a wingspan of **65m, **and a height of **17m.**
 
• **Capacity of Flying-V: **to accommodate 314 passengers and hold 160m3 of cargo.
